proof_groups.proof_strategy: Process the witnesses in manual order as one predecessor-cut/rebuild family. For entail_wit_1, derive the first-occurrence prefix/suffix from membership, open xizi_dll, split its segment at the anchor, then split the prefix by list_snoc_destruct: nil gives predecessor=head, while prefix0++prev::nil exposes the interior predecessor and prefix segment. Rewrite xizi_double_link_insert_before_nodes with the first-occurrence equation. For return_wit_1, rewrite nodes_before=prefix0++prev::nil and the generated result equality, normalize updated fields into links, construct prev::inserted::anchor::suffix, join it to the prefix segment, and close xizi_dll. For return_wit_2, substitute the empty-prefix equalities, use inserted as the new first node, construct inserted::anchor::suffix, and close the DLL. The current statement-matched proof bodies are complete proof candidates; validate them with group-check and adapt locally only if fixed compilation feedback requires it. No case_lib helper is expected.
